SELECT leadershipSkills, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT frameVersion) AS frames,
       COUNT(*) AS rows, COUNT(cardKingdomFoilId) AS foil_ids, COUNT(cardKingdomId) AS regular_ids,
       SUM(cardKingdomFoilId = '' OR cardKingdomId = '') AS blank_ids
FROM main.cards
GROUP BY leadershipSkills

arguments.sql:
SELECT CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER) AS frame_year, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM main.cards
WHERE INSTR(leadershipSkills, '''commander'': True') > 0
  AND cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL
  AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
  AND frameVersion GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]'
GROUP BY frame_year
ORDER BY frame_year DESC
LIMIT 1
